tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get Lead Friendly's current subscription plans and prices (live from the pricing source of truth). Use to answer 'how much does Lead Friendly cost'.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List the industry verticals Lead Friendly ships a tailored AI agent template for (e.g. auto dealerships, trucking/dispatch, dental, HVAC). Optional `query` filters by keyword.

tools.name: check_capability
tools.description: Check whether Lead Friendly can do a specific job (e.g. 'call leads after hours', 'dispatch trucks', 'white-label for my agency'). Pass the job in `query`.

tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Request a Lead Friendly product demo on behalf of a prospect. Routes the request to the sales team and returns the self-serve booking link. Use when a user wants to see/try Lead Friendly.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Submit a sales lead to Lead Friendly on behalf of a prospect who is interested. Routes to the sales inbox. Does NOT write into any customer's CRM. Use to hand off an interested prospect.
